caption: The drawing depicts a corner of a room with built-in wooden cabinetry. The cabinetry, colored in varying warm shades of brown and orange, occupies the right half of the composition and consists of a tall unit with seven horizontally stacked drawers, each with a round knob, and a cupboard with a rectangular panel at the top. To the left is a vertical cabinet door with a matching knob, and below it, extending across the lower part of the wall, is a short horizontal baseboard in a similar wood tone. The wall behind the cabinetry is painted a light beige color. A dark, rectangular metal vent or register is set into the lower left part of the wall near the floor, with a visible round handle. A horizontal wooden rail with evenly spaced round pegs runs along the left wall and continues to the back wall at the same height as the bottom of the window, matching the color of the cabinetry. The floor appears brown and unadorned, and the composition is framed with a simple cream-colored border.
title: Shaker Built-In Cupboard
